On today’s high-impact episode of Quick Ch a rge , we’ve got a flurry of fatal Tesla crashes allegedly involving Autopilot and FSD making headlines – and they all feel weirdly familiar. Is there any way to keep this from happening again?
As Electrek ‘s ongoing investigation into fatal crashes hidden in Tesla’s NHTSA data continues , a number of recently matched fatal crashes involving Autopilot and/or FSD have been making headlines. In addition to being tragedies, they seem all too familiar, drawing comparisons to older incidents that occurred under similar conditions while raising questions about whether possible solutions might already exist.
That said, no one is keeping a record of all the crashes avoided by Autopilot or FSD, and I can think of at least one or two jams my ADAS has helped me avoid in recent weeks that have made the technology worth all the money.
After that, we’ve got a few irresponsible maniacs asleep at the wheel while a few more teach them new and exciting ways to get away with it.
